item.title: August Community Update
item.description:
Hello Space Marines!

You know the drill now! The end of the month means new info about Space Marine 2!
Let us reveal some of the content of Patch 15, the Community Event and a few words about modding. 

PATCH 15 🔜​

We’re working on Patch 15, making sure everything is ready before it reaches your hands. In the meantime, let’s dive into some of the content coming with this update:

CHAOS SIEGE MODE

As you know, Chaos Siege Mode is coming with Patch 15 bringing a new challenge to the game. In this mode, you’ll play with Chaos Space Marines on a brand new Siege map located on Avarax. You’ll face Tyranids and Loyalists waves, receive the support of Chaos Cultists and Ritualists, and you’ll be able to deploy a Helbrute to wreak havoc on the battlefield.

[carousel][/carousel]

ONE-HANDED THUNDER HAMMER

We’re adding the One-Hander Thunder Hammer, a fast weapon that can transition between single target and area attacks. Available for the Tactical (! more info below), Assault, Bulwark and Techmarine classes.

CRUCIBLE MODE

“The Crucible awaits, Brother. Will you submit to the test?”  

A new game mode will also be added: the Crucible Mode. 

Talk to our beloved Chapter Chaplain to set up your Penance before going into an Operation. Penances are personal debuffs that will make your mission even harder. They will grant you Purity XP if you succeed the Operation, which will let you unlock unique customisation items and armour parts. 

Each Penance has a tier, each with its own set of challenges and rewards. The more debuffs you pick, the more XP you get, but the harder the challenge, so choose wisely! Since Crucible is designed to be an end game challenge, your class must be level 25 to participate.

TACTICAL REWORK

We teased it in a previous Community Update, the Tactical class will receive a major rework to support more versatile playstyles. His Perk Tree in particular will be more diverse and will allow for more creativity in the build. A frequent request was to expand his melee arsenal: it will now be possible to equip a Power Sword, Power Axe or One Handed Thunder Hammer at the expense of his Primary Weapon for a melee build.

If you’re more into distance fights, a Class Perk will allow you to replace your Secondary Weapon with a Primary Bolt Rifle.

“SOMETHING WE SHOULD HAVE DONE A LONG TIME AGO”

A few community updates ago, we told you that we were working on “something we should have done a long time ago”. The something in question being: Cape Recolour. Take a first look:

Work in progress, final version subject to change.

🎂 SECOND ANNIVERSARY UPDATE

First of all, we’d like to thank you for these two incredible years of Space Marine 2, and for your continued support throughout this journey. The enthusiasm you’ve shown for the game and its updates continues to motivate us to keep bringing new content and experiences to the battlefield. 

As we reach this two-year milestone, we’re excited to share that the Second Anniversary Update will arrive early October! 🎉

And that’s not all: Season Pass 3 will also be available on the same day, bringing even more content for you to discover following the same formula as for Year 2 and Year 1.

We’re really excited about what’s coming, and we hope you’ll be just as excited to join us for another year of Space Marine 2! And as a little token of appreciation, we can confirm that yes, you’ll have your Greatsword in Year 3.

💥 COMMUNITY EVENT

​The Community Event of the month is live since yesterday! You have until September 8 to complete 3 Chaos PvE missions (Vox Liberatis, Reliquary, Fall of Atreus, Obelisk, Vortex, Disruption or Purgation) to earn 100 accolades and 150 requisition points.

Onward, Space Marines!

GRATEFUL FOR THE MODDING COMMUNITY

We’re grateful to see how much excitement the launch of the Steam Workshop has brought to the modding community of Space Marine 2.

Since the launch of the modding tool, we’ve seen an amazing amount of creativity from you, with new ideas and creations popping up… some of them have definitely made us smile! So, a big thank you to everyone contributing to the modding scene. It’s great to see you finding new ways to play around with Space Marine 2 and keeping the community buzzing with new creations! Keep them coming!! 👀 

If you’re interested in creating mods, you can check our guidelines here, or check the Steam Workshop to browse the available mods.

And that’s it for this month!

Thank you for supporting us and helping us improve Space Marine 2. In next month’s Community Update, we’ll reveal the full Year 3 Roadmap, followed by a Q&A session with our Game Director on Reddit, so make sure to follow us on our social media channels to get the news: X, Facebook, Threads and Bluesky.

🪽​ The Emperor Protects.

The Saber and Focus teams

item.title: Any road is better with good company
item.description:
Lord Captains!
If you enjoy travelling with a group of characters whose stories develop alongside your own, you might like Shadow of the Road - to be released on 12 November 2026.

The Koronus Expanse is upheld by the Imperium's vast and often incomprehensible machinery, whereas Shadow of the Road's Nippon is being transformed by the arrival of foreign technology and the ambitions of the East Nippon Company. In both cases, the cast of main characters find themselves moving through a world where the old order is no longer quite as stable as it once was.



Set in a fantastical reimagining of 1868 Japan, Shadow of the Road is a story-driven tactical RPG about a group of travellers crossing the nation of Nippon caught between tradition and rapid change. Along the way, the companions will grow closer, clash with one another, and react to the choices you make - while turn-based battles will put your positioning, abilities, and initiative management to the test.

While Shadow of the Road doesn't offer the same intensity of deep character-building as Rogue Trader, it is quite deliberate: rather than spending your journey calculating the most devastating combination of abilities, the focus is on mastering the combat and experiencing the story. There are options to build your party and experiment with their abilities - but the journey is more important.

As in Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader, the party is more than just a collection of combatants. Each of the companions brings their own beliefs, personalities, ambitions, and baggage aboard, creating relationships that may fracture or deepen as the story unfolds. Your choices help shape those connections as they make their way through a country being transformed around them.

Both games also place their characters in worlds where the supernatural can intrude upon everyday life - although the scale is certainly different. In Rogue Trader, the Warp is overwhelmingly terrifying. In Shadow of the Road, yōkai bring a more mysterious and varied supernatural presence to Nippon, ranging from mischievous spirits to entities that are genuinely malicious and dangerous. That, in turn, allows the characters to interact with the supernatural a lot more closely - without being branded heretics!

If you enjoyed Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader for its memorable companions, story choices, and a world where your actions can leave a mark - perhaps it's time to gather another group and see where the road takes you.

The old world is fading, and new companions await you to take on the new road.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1173980/Shadow_of_the_Road/


Join Shadow of the Road on the following social platforms for news and more!

And other platforms!

📍 Instagram

📍 Youtube
